title: Advantage Data Vision Wins Merit Award in Future Challenge (Open Track)
html:
August 26, 2025 — Advantage Data Vision announced it has received a Merit Award in the Future Challenge (Open Track), recognizing the company’s progress in AI-driven healthcare and the impact potential of its Virtual Patient Simulation System.

“Our mission is simple: translate data into the benefits of lives. This recognition energizes our team to accelerate responsible clinical adoption,” said Dr. Lawrence Chan, Founder of Advantage Data Vision.
